recap.text: Rend is a Tummy Acher and pet-class mob who came to Carl as a reset level one gift from CrawlCon. Kibben, an old stablemaster, remembers Rend from a previous incarnation. Carl fits Rend with the Enchanted Tooth Cap of Hi-Yo Silver, which pulls Rend toward him at great speed. Rend uses Wrecking Ball to roll over the back half of Gustavo 3, leaving a red mist, and giggles when a defence tower bolt hits him.

Rend shoulders past Jamal into a safe room and giggles as Mordecai enters with empty potion balls. Mordecai floats into the air and tells Rend he perishes once again, and Rend drops dead. He rises from his sixth death bigger and stronger with a weakness to potatoes. Rend rides the head of a spiked turtle in a fight, then licks a bloody horribles mask.

beats.headline: A gift for attending
beats.text: Subject is a Tummy Acher, a pet-class mob built to absorb damage. He came to Tserendolgor as a gift for attending CrawlCon, and to Carl when she was gone, reset to level one with no name and no memory; the one he answers to now is Louis's work. Tserendolgor took delivery of a party favour. What the group has now is a tank that levels every time it goes hunting, which is not what a party favour is for.
beats.gist: Rend is a Tummy Acher pet-class mob built to absorb damage.

beats.headline: A special one
beats.text: Kibben, the old stablemaster from the high elf castle, takes charge of Rend and Mongo while Carl and Donut ride out to the parlay. He bounces a treat off Rend's head and has him chasing it. Tummy acher or belly acher, Carl asks. No real difference, Kibben says; they call them bellies when they get extra big. And he remembers this one from his last incarnation. Even on his first run he was pretty big. He's a special one. Rend comes back chewing, and purrs.
beats.gist: Kibben takes charge of Rend and Mongo while Carl and Donut ride to the parlay.

beats.headline: Hi-Yo Silver
beats.text: Donated item fitted: the Enchanted Tooth Cap of Hi-Yo Silver, a mount's cap placed over subject's single round tooth, which now gleams. It lets Carl summon subject to his position from about five kilometres, on a three-minute cooldown. It is not a teleport. Subject is pulled toward Carl at great speed and, if a wall is in the way, possibly through it, which pairs with his new Wrecking Ball ability. Princess Donut refused it for Mongo on the grounds that it is dangerous. Louis and Elle nearly came to blows over the spelling.
beats.gist: Carl fits the Enchanted Tooth Cap of Hi-Yo Silver on Rend's single round tooth.

beats.headline: Wrecking Ball
beats.text: Carl cast Hi-Yo Silver a second time and called Wrecking Ball. Subject, much bigger than when last seen, came over the ridge and rolled toward him at speed, with Gustavo 3 and Mongo directly between them. The dog had the unconscious dinosaur by the neck. The back half of Gustavo 3, the second of Lucia Mar's two rottweilers, left in a red mist. Subject stopped inches from Carl's face. Carl called him a good boy. A defence tower's bolt then hit subject squarely. He barely moved. He giggled.
beats.gist: Carl casts Hi-Yo Silver and calls Wrecking Ball, who rolls over a ridge with an unconscious dinosaur.

beats.headline: Killed by a look
beats.text: Subject shoulders past Jamal into the safe room behind a drunk Mongo, giggling, at the moment Mordecai walks in with an armful of empty potion balls. Mordecai stops in the middle of his sentence, drops the lot, rises into the air, turns to Rend, and speaks in a voice that is deep and ominous and not his usual one: "And now you perish once again. The next time will herald the beginning of the end." Rend drops dead where he stands. Your pet has died.
beats.gist: Rend shoulders past Jamal into a safe room and drops dead after Mordecai speaks.

beats.headline: A sixth death, and potatoes
beats.text: Subject rises from the dead on the safe room floor, giggling. It is his sixth death, so he keeps his memories and identity, and he comes back a quarter stronger, bigger, and with a new random weakness added to the list under Reaper Gaze: potatoes. Crawler Carl disputes that it was random. The rest is housekeeping. He cannot stay in the safe room, he cannot be let into the garage, and so he goes back into his carrier until there is something to fight.
beats.gist: Rend rises from the safe room floor giggling after his sixth death.

beats.headline: Eat the rich
beats.text: After the arena. Rend sits against Crawler Carl's side licking a bloody horribles mask. Before the fight he did not want to leave Carl, and went to the RV only when Donut called. In the fight he rode the head of a spiked turtle while Mongo pulled its leg out of the shell. Carl says eat the rich. Rend looks up with his tongue out, and says, for the record, yum.
beats.gist: Rend licks a bloody horribles mask and tells Carl that the rich taste like yum.
